profile.name: Caxton Kiptoo
profile.headline: Statistics and Data Science Student
profile.subtitle: Aspiring Data Scientist, Analyst and Engineer
profile.summary: Statistics and Data Science student at Strathmore University building practical data analysis and machine learning projects using Python. Interested in turning data into meaningful insights that support informed decision-making.
profile.tagline: Turning Data into Insights, Solutions, Decisions

key projects: Kenyan Misinformation Detector: Fine-tuning AfroXLMR-Base to detect political misinformation in Kiswahili, Sheng, and English is a genuinely standout NLP project. It shows you can work with transformers and real-world regional data, not just clean CSVs.

Sales Forecasting & Business Intelligence: Built an end-to-end retail analytics pipeline using Python (SARIMA) for time-series sales forecasting and Power BI for interactive dashboarding, analyzing regional trends, product category profitability, and discount strategies to surface actionable business insights.

Customer Churn Prediction System: Engineered and evaluated multiple classification models (including Logistic Regression) in Scikit-learn to predict high-risk customer churn, deploying the final pipeline as an interactive Streamlit web application.
Financial Inclusion Prediction: Comparing 4 ML models on the Financial Inclusion in Africa dataset is much stronger and more relevant to the East African market than a generic house price regression.
experience: BSc. Statistics and Data Science coursework projects; individual and group projects and assignments
